objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with sudden loss of vision in one eye.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I suddenly lost vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago, and it was painless—I noticed it while watching TV.

Did the vision loss affect the entire right eye, or only part of the visual field?
Did the vision loss affect the entire right eye, or only part of the visual field?
It feels like it affected the whole right eye—my vision went out throughout, not just in one part of the field.
Are you completely unable to see out of the right eye, or is it blurry/dim? Any flashing lights, floaters, or a curtain-like shadow?
Patient: I’m completely unable to see out of the right eye—it’s not just blurry or dim. I didn’t notice any flashing lights, floaters, or a curtain-like shadow, just sudden vision going out.
Any eye pain, headache, jaw pain when chewing, scalp tenderness, or recent temple pain?
“No, I don’t have any eye pain. I also haven’t had a headache, jaw pain when chewing, scalp tenderness, or any recent temple pain.”
Any weakness, numbness, trouble speaking, facial droop, dizziness, or trouble walking since this started?
“No—since it started, I haven’t noticed any weakness or numbness, trouble speaking, facial droop, dizziness, or trouble walking.”
How old are you, and do you have any history of high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, smoking, atrial fibrillation, stroke/TIA, or carotid artery disease?

I’m 60 years old, and I have high blood pressure, type 2 diabetes, and coronary artery disease. I’m not sure about high cholesterol, I don’t recall smoking, I don’t know if I have atrial fibrillation, and I haven’t had a stroke/TIA or been told I have carotid artery disease.
Have you had any recent episodes of brief vision loss in that eye before today, or any recent neck trauma, neck pain, or eye procedures?
“No—this is the first time I’ve had any sudden vision loss in that eye. I haven’t had any recent neck trauma or neck pain, and I haven’t had any eye procedures.”
[DDX] Central retinal artery occlusion, Ophthalmic artery occlusion, Central retinal vein occlusion, Retinal detachment, Ischemic optic neuropathy
